summary: Richard Lindsey is a candidate for Alabama House District 39 in the 2014 election. He was an incumbent representing the district since 1983 and previously chaired the Education Finance and Appropriations Committee. Ideologically, his Shor–McCarty score places him around the 92nd conservative percentile of the Alabama Democratic House caucus, making him conservative relative to fellow Democrats while aligned with the education establishment. His positions on abortion or guns are unknown as no time-valid evidence has been recovered for these dimensions.
